# Performance history

<!-- Generated by src/XLibur.PerfReport on the perf-history branch. Do not edit by hand. -->

XLibur's own benchmarks, run on a GitHub-hosted runner when a release is published. A shared runner is noisy, so these numbers detect change between releases; they are not authoritative. Allocated bytes are deterministic and are flagged when they rise by more than 5% over the previous release. Time is flagged when it is more than 30% over the median of the last five releases, and is indicative only. A benchmark whose source or parameters changed shows `re-baselined` and is not flagged for that release. Pre-release tags and manual runs are stored but left out of the baselines and these tables.

Comparisons with other libraries, on the published NuGet package, live in [XLBench](https://jafin.github.io/XLBench/) ([changelog](https://github.com/jafin/XLBench/blob/main/CHANGELOG.md)).
